  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]

- requirement: Skip reviews when the PR head is invalid, unavailable, or inconsistent with the files checked out, rather than falling back to the default branch.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` — `pr_head_repo_gate`, `review_checkout_sha`, and checkout-step stale-head guards
